ἀναβὰς: ἀναβαίνω — go up, climb; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’having climbed’
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς) · also of fighting, ’head-on, face to face’ (ἀντικρὺ μάχεσθαι ’to fight head-on’)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπειλάων: ἀπειλή — threat; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀρήρει: ἀραρίσκω — fit, fit together; plpf. 3 sg. with intransitive impf. sense, epic: ’was fitted’
ἀρήϊος: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; masc. nom. sg.
ἀραρυίας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic reduplicated -υῖα, no Attic prose equivalent: ’fitted’
ἀργαλέῳ: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄσθματι: ’grievous (gasping)’
ἀργυρέοισιν: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic ἀργυροῖς), agreeing with ἐπισφυρίοις · also agreeing with ἱμᾶσιν: ’(straps) of silver’
ἀριστερὸν: ἀριστερός — left, on the left hand; masc. acc. sg., with ὦμον
ἀσπιδιώτας: ἀσπιδιώτης — shield-bearing, armed with a shield; masc. acc. pl.
ἀστερόεντα: ἀστερόεις — starry; masc. acc. sg., with οὐρανόν
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’which’
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄκρον: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun or adverb: ’the top, at the top’
ἄλκιμα: ἄλκιμος — stout, valiant (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δοῦρε
ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’valiant’
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄνωγε: ἄνωγα — command, bid, order; perf. with pres./past force, 3 sg.: ’bids, bade’
ἄορι: ἄορ — sword; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with a sword’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄσθματι: ἄσθμα (also ἆσθμα) — panting, gasping; neut. dat. sg.
ἄσπετος: ἄσπετος — boundless, immense; masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπίκλησιν: ἐπίκλησις — surname, byname; fem. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by surname’
ἐπίστατο: ἐπίσταμαι — know, know how to; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἠπίστατο)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπισφυρίοις: ἐπισφύριον — ankle-piece, ankle-clasp (of a greave); neut. dat. pl.
ἐποιχόμενος: ἐποίχομαι — go against, assail, come upon; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’assailing, going about’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; masc. nom. sg.
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’his own’ · also neut. nom. sg., with the article, of one’s belongings: ’his own’ (τὸ δ’ ἑὸν ’his own’)
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔδυνε: δύνω (by-form of δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’put on’

ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
ἔλαφον: ἔλαφος — deer, stag; masc./fem. acc. sg.
ἔμιμνε: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔμενε): ’remained’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’steady’
ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνέπεσε): ’fell on’
ἔνευεν: νεύω — nod; impf. 3 sg. with ν-movable (= Attic ἔνευε): ’nodded’
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί) · also ἔνι = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι, accented on the first syllable: ’is in, are in’ (οὔ οἱ ἔνι φρένες ’there are no wits in him’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρρεεν: ῥέω — flow, run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρρει)
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative -σκ- form: ’was, used to be’
ἔσπετε: ἐννέπω — tell, say; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic ἔσπετε (= Attic εἴπατε): ’tell!’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔτεκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’bore’
ἔτελλε: τέλλω — with ἐπί (ἐπιτέλλω), ’enjoin, lay a charge on’; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
ἔτρεφε: τρέφω — rear, nurse, bring up; impf. 3 sg. act.
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἔχετ: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. cling, hold on; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἔχετ’ = ἔχετο): ’kept holding on’ · also impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., of being gripped by an affliction (dat.): ’was held, gripped’ (ἀργαλέῳ … ἄσθματι ’by grievous gasping’)
ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλετ: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided and unaugmented (ἕλετ’ = ἕλετο = εἵλετο)
ἠγάγετο: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. take with oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’brought with him’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
ἠετίωνος: Ἠετίων — Eëtion, king of Thebe, father of Andromache; masc. gen. sg.
ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address: ’leaders!’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject of ἧντ’: ’leaders (were sitting)’
ἡγεμόνας: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. acc. pl.
ἡγεμόνεσσιν: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -όσι)
ἡγεμόνευε: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be leader (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. (augment not visible on ἡ-)
ἡγεῖτο: ἡγέομαι — lead, go first (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was leading’
ἡρώεσσιν: ἥρως — hero; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἥρωσιν)
ἤγαγ: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (ἤγαγ’ = ἤγαγε): ’brought’
ἤνασσε: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord of, + gen.; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’he ruled’
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰφθίμῳ: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout; adj. of two endings, neut. dat. sg. · also masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοί: ’(me) mighty’
ἱππηλάτα: ἱππηλάτης — horse-driver, charioteer; masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α, epithet of heroes
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’
ἵππουριν: ἵππουρις — with a horsehair plume; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ἵστατ: ἵστημι — set; mid. stand, rise; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵστατ’ = ἵστατο): ’rose, stood up’
ὀλύμπια: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ὀτρύνων: ὀτρύνω — urge on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’urging’
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
ὄρσεο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid. (ὄρσεο = ὄρσο): ’rise!’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’)
ὑψιβρεμέτης: ὑψιβρεμέτης — thundering on high; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὕπαγε: ὑπάγω — lead away, draw off; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὑπῆγε): ’drew away’
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥίγησέν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable, accent shifted before the enclitic τε: ’shuddered’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηξήνορα: ῥηξήνωρ — man-breaking, breaker of men; adj., masc. acc. sg., epithet of Achilles
ῥόον: ῥόος — stream, flow; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥοῦς): ’stream’
ῥώοντ: ῥώομαι — rush, dash, move swiftly; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., unaugmented, elided (ῥώοντ’ = ῥώοντο; no Attic prose form)
